providers.market_view: US equities enter the pre-Thanksgiving week with mixed technical posture following a broad earnings season that has produced sharp post-report moves in small and mid-cap names. Many recent breakout candidates have already realized substantial gains, leaving limited fresh setups with favorable risk-reward for a 1-5 session horizon. Volume typically contracts into the holiday, increasing mean-reversion risk for extended positions. The market lacks a clear catalyst cluster with verifiable timing that hasn't already been discounted, and regulatory decision dates require official sources not independently confirmed at this cutoff.

Tape was in corrective, selective mode into Nov 19 pre-open, with AI-valuation reset and software-disruption worries pressuring broad tech while a record AI IPO pricing revived infrastructure enthusiasm. Leadership narrow, breadth fragile, rotation toward defensive and proven AI hardware/power stories. Favor fresh beat-and-raise with muted reaction and event-driven follow-through, avoid chasing extended premarket pops.
